FinAstro 2027 — New York calendar

Financial astrology is a speculative interpretive framework. Dates are computed; interpretations are the sources' own claims, quoted. Nothing here is a forecast or investment advice. Times: America/New_York (EST/EDT); IST alongside. 1610 events from the two reference PDFs, 601 existing calendar rows (463 carry PDF text). Moon-only conditions (4566) are in the separate Moon-layer files.

Deep dives (every sky event backtested, week by week): January 2027 · February 2027

Deep dive: January 2027: every sky event backtested

Weeks: 01–07 Jan08–14 Jan15–21 Jan22–28 Jan29–31 Jan

2087 tests over 5 weeks: 0 pass the Benjamini–Hochberg correction (within each week), and 44 have a nominal p < 0.05, against about 104 expected by chance. Big days: 0 event classes pass. The sky events of January carry no measurable direction or big-day signal. Method: every event of each day (exact aspects, sign and nakshatra entries, stations, combustion and rising, eclipses, speed overtakes, the Sun's and Moon's apsides, tithi, yoga, Bhadra, lunations) is turned into its event class and scored on every occurrence from 20 Nov 2000 to 20 Nov 2026 on the S&P 500, Sensex, gold and silver: next session and 5 sessions, two-sided, plus big days. The labels, the model and the rules with a supported record are built the same way as the December days of the 2026 calendar.
Double-checked: 20 of 20 checks pass (event times re-derived from the ephemeris, occurrence counts against expected frequencies, one result per week recounted from raw prices with separate code, every sky event classified).
Holidays: Fri 01 Jan New Year's Day: S&P 500, gold, silver closed; Mon 18 Jan Martin Luther King Jr. Day: S&P 500, gold, silver closed; Tue 26 Jan Republic Day: Sensex closed. The BSE has not yet published its 2027 holiday list; only fixed holidays are assumed.
How far to trust the labels and the model: After the November 2026 review (2026 calendar, section “November review”): Low labels are leans, not day calls, and the model's percentages are no longer coloured. Tested out of sample (2013–2026, everything chosen on earlier years), neither the labels nor the model beat chance on any market; treat both as leanings.
The year: lord of the year 2026–27 Mercury (US time) or Jupiter (Indian time), watch list only. NYSE ruler of the year Moon, strength 12.44, house 1. Both test at chance.

NYSE monthly charts (Tajika, Model B) in force during January, all at chance on the S&P 1928–2026:

  • 2026-12-22 05:20 ET: navamsha 2nd-house rule no call, 11th-house rule Bullish; sahams Wealth no call, Trade no call, Business Bullish; Sun in house 2
  • 2027-01-20 16:03 ET: navamsha 2nd-house rule no call, 11th-house rule Bearish; sahams Wealth Bullish, Trade no call, Business Bullish; Sun in house 8

Deep dive: February 2027: every sky event backtested

Weeks: 01–07 Feb08–14 Feb15–21 Feb22–28 Feb

1827 tests over 4 weeks: 0 pass the Benjamini–Hochberg correction (within each week), and 43 have a nominal p < 0.05, against about 91 expected by chance. Big days: 0 event classes pass. The sky events of February carry no measurable direction or big-day signal. Method: every event of each day (exact aspects, sign and nakshatra entries, stations, combustion and rising, eclipses, speed overtakes, the Sun's and Moon's apsides, tithi, yoga, Bhadra, lunations) is turned into its event class and scored on every occurrence from 20 Nov 2000 to 20 Nov 2026 on the S&P 500, Sensex, gold and silver: next session and 5 sessions, two-sided, plus big days. The labels, the model and the rules with a supported record are built the same way as the December days of the 2026 calendar.
Double-checked: 16 of 16 checks pass (event times re-derived from the ephemeris, occurrence counts against expected frequencies, one result per week recounted from raw prices with separate code, every sky event classified).
Holidays: Mon 15 Feb Presidents' Day: S&P 500, gold, silver closed. The BSE has not yet published its 2027 holiday list; only fixed holidays are assumed.
How far to trust the labels and the model: After the November 2026 review (2026 calendar, section “November review”): Low labels are leans, not day calls, and the model's percentages are no longer coloured. Tested out of sample (2013–2026, everything chosen on earlier years), neither the labels nor the model beat chance on any market; treat both as leanings.
The year: lord of the year 2026–27 Mercury (US time) or Jupiter (Indian time), watch list only. NYSE ruler of the year Moon, strength 12.44, house 1. Both test at chance.

Conditions & qualifications
TA footer: (R) MEANS RETROGRADE. | TA p.66 bottom NOTE: THIS IS JUST PLACEMENT OF PLANET WHICH HAS VERY SMALL ROLE TO PLAY IN DECIDING BULLISH/BEARISH MARKETS SO SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN AS EXCLUSIVE RESULTS BASED ON IT.

Calculation method
Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. 'Any 2' = at least two of the listed bodies in the sign at once, each meeting its (R) condition. Financial market significance
Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Vedha of Punarvasu, Pushya, Chitra or Dhanishta (gold)
Planetary condition
Computed: value: MALEFIC vedha (Sun->Punarvasu, Sun->Chitra, Mars->Dhanishta, Ketu->Dhanishta) - Gold Bullish (extreme if more than 1 malefic) - more than one malefic: stronger | BENEFIC vedha (Jupiter->Dhanishta) - Gold Bearish (high if more than 1 benefic)
Astrological rule
A malefic or benefic planet's Vedha falls on Punarvasu, Pushya, Chitra, Dhanishta.
Source interpretation
Vedha of Punarvasu, Pushya, Chitra or Dhanishta (gold): Malefic Vedha: Gold Bullish (extreme if more than 1 malefic); Benefic Vedha: Gold Bearish (high if more than 1 benefic)
Financial market significance
Malefic Vedha: Gold Bullish (extreme if more than 1 malefic); Benefic Vedha: Gold Bearish (high if more than 1 benefic) -> Gold (XAUUSD / COMEX GC) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
TA p.137: Moon, Mercury, Jupiter & Venus benefic (their Vedha Bearish); Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu & Ketu malefic (their Vedha Bullish & reverses the trend).
Source reference

Planetary condition
At start: Moon 09.68 deg Libra (Swati pada 1; D9 Sagittarius), 13.306 deg/day | At end: Moon 16.16 deg Libra (Swati pada 3; D9 Aquarius), 13.126 deg/day | Computed: tithi: Krishna Tritiya; moon sign at start: Libra; loka: Patal (hell) - no effect here, beneficial; type: Night Bhadra; mostly in NY daytime: False; day night rule: Night Bhadra in night time - Negative
Astrological rule
Each Vishti karana: Moon's sign at its start fixes the loka; Day Bhadra = Shukla 8/15, Krishna 7/14; Night Bhadra = Shukla 4/11, Krishna 3/10.
Source interpretation
Bhadra (Vishti karana): loka and day/night effect: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive
Financial market significance
Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
'Starts in' read as the Moon's sign at the Bhadra's start. | Day/night judged at New York; Indian timing differs by ~10 h.
Source reference
TA p.121-122 [printed 91-92] Section 28 'Bhadra & its effect' (Muhurta Chintamani)
Calculation method
Vishti karana spans from the astronomy layer (6deg elongation steps); Moon sign at the start; share of the window between New York sunrise and sunset (>= 50% = day time). || Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph, sepl/semo 18 files), sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, mean lunar node, whole-sign relationships; condition sampled hourly and every boundary bisected to 30 seconds; times shown in New York local time (EST/EDT by IANA America/New_York) with IST alongside.

Astrological rule
Each Vishti karana: Moon's sign at its start fixes the loka; Day Bhadra = Shukla 8/15, Krishna 7/14; Night Bhadra = Shukla 4/11, Krishna 3/10.
Source interpretation
Bhadra (Vishti karana): loka and day/night effect: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive
Financial market significance
Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)

Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Waxing = Shukla paksha (elongation 0-180 deg). Moon rise after Amavasya: weekday and tithi.
Source interpretation
Moon rise after Amavasya: weekday and tithi: Pratipada: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat - fortnight high Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu - slight Bullish, sideways by Purnima. Dwitiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat slight Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu slight Bearish. Tritiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat stable small movement; Mon/Wed/Thu one sided Bearish
Financial market significance
Pratipada: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat - fortnight high Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu - slight Bullish, sideways by Purnima. Dwitiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat slight Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu slight Bearish. Tritiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat stable small movement; Mon/Wed/Thu one sided Bearish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)

'Moon rise' / 'Moon darshan' read as the first evening sighting after Amavasya (Chandra Darshan). Operational criterion (not in either PDF): first New York sunset with elongation >= 12 deg and Moon age >= 20 h. Source interpretation
Mercury combustion type (7 types): Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish
Financial market significance
Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
Type assigned from the combustion's length in days using midpoints between the printed nominal durations (40/30/22.5/18/15/10.5/9); TA p.26 calls Prakruta a 'speed of Mercury', so the type is a speed class and the length is its proxy. | TA p.70: If combustion Bullish but aspected by malefic - Bearish; if Bearish but aspected by benefic - Bullish. | TA p.70: If combust in direct motion: starts Bearish but Bullish after conjunction with Sun; if combust in retrogression it is Bullish. | TA p.70: Bullishness returns after speed of Mercury crosses speed of Venus (see 'Mercury Manifestation'). | Combust/rise dates are civil dates, not instants: the event is date-only.
Source reference
TA p.69 [printed 39] Section 17 | TA p.51 [printed 21] Section 10 (2016 Prakruta example) | TA p.26, p.29

Financial market significance
Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Astrological rule
Each Vishti karana: Moon's sign at its start fixes the loka; Day Bhadra = Shukla 8/15, Krishna 7/14; Night Bhadra = Shukla 4/11, Krishna 3/10.
Source interpretation
Bhadra (Vishti karana): loka and day/night effect: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive
Financial market significance
Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
'Starts in' read as the Moon's sign at the Bhadra's start. | Day/night judged at New York; Indian timing differs by ~10 h.

Moon rise after Amavasya: weekday and tithi.
Source interpretation
Moon rise after Amavasya: weekday and tithi: Pratipada: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat - fortnight high Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu - slight Bullish, sideways by Purnima. Dwitiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat slight Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu slight Bearish. Tritiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat stable small movement; Mon/Wed/Thu one sided Bearish
Financial market significance
Pratipada: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat - fortnight high Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu - slight Bullish, sideways by Purnima. Dwitiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat slight Bullish; Mon/Wed/Thu slight Bearish. Tritiya: Sun/Tue/Fri/Sat stable small movement; Mon/Wed/Thu one sided Bearish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
'Moon rise' / 'Moon darshan' read as the first evening sighting after Amavasya (Chandra Darshan). Operational criterion (not in either PDF): first New York sunset with elongation >= 12 deg and Moon age >= 20 h. Can trigger gold price hike (Bullish) -> Gold (XAUUSD / COMEX GC) (as the source states it; not a forecast)

Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Both sources are shown. | Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.

Both sources are shown. | Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.

Astrological rule
In Cancer (sign type: Bearish): Jupiter, Venus, Mercury & Neptune any 2 together. (R) means retrograde. || With Mercury, Jupiter, Moon, Neptune - Bearish || Mercury and Venus in one sign with a TA malefic (Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu; the Sun is always within 48 deg so its 7th aspect cannot fall there) casting drishti on that sign.
Source interpretation
Cancer: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury & Neptune any 2 together: very Bearish || Venus With Mercury, Jupiter, Moon, Neptune: Bearish || Mercury & Venus together, aspected by a malefic: Bullish till the point of conjunction & Bearish thereafter (examples: Oct 1929 crash; 6 Aug 2015; 22 May 2020)
Financial market significance
very Bearish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named); Bearish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named); Bullish till the point of conjunction & Bearish thereafter (examples: Oct 1929 crash; 6 Aug 2015; 22 May 2020) -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named), Commodities (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
TA footer: (R) MEANS RETROGRADE. | TA p.66 bottom NOTE: THIS IS JUST PLACEMENT OF PLANET WHICH HAS VERY SMALL ROLE TO PLAY IN DECIDING BULLISH/BEARISH MARKETS SO SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN AS EXCLUSIVE RESULTS BASED ON IT. | A Moon companion is not evaluated in this row (it would add a ~2.5-day window every month); see the Moon layer.

Calculation method
Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. 'Any 2' = at least two of the listed bodies in the sign at once, each meeting its (R) condition. Retrograde = of-date longitudinal speed < 0 (station instants as almanacs define them); Rahu/Ketu always retrograde (TA p.73). || Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Companion = in the same sign. Retrograde = of-date longitudinal speed < 0 (station instants as almanacs define them); Rahu/Ketu always retrograde (TA p.73). || Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Malefic drishti by whole sign (Mars 4/7/8, Saturn 3/7/10, nodes 7). || Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph, sepl/semo 18 files), sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, mean lunar node, whole-sign relationships; condition sampled hourly and every boundary bisected to 30 seconds; times shown in New York local time (EST/EDT by IANA America/New_York) with IST alongside.

Astrological rule
Mercury combustion type (7 types).
Source interpretation
Mercury combustion type (7 types): Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish
Financial market significance
Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
Type assigned from the combustion's length in days using midpoints between the printed nominal durations (40/30/22.5/18/15/10.5/9); TA p.26 calls Prakruta a 'speed of Mercury', so the type is a speed class and the length is its proxy. | TA p.70: If combustion Bullish but aspected by malefic - Bearish; if Bearish but aspected by benefic - Bullish. | TA p.70: If combust in direct motion: starts Bearish but Bullish after conjunction with Sun; if combust in retrogression it is Bullish. | TA p.70: Bullishness returns after speed of Mercury crosses speed of Venus (see 'Mercury Manifestation'). | Combust/rise dates are civil dates, not instants: the event is date-only.
Source reference
TA p.69 [printed 39] Section 17 | TA p.51 [printed 21] Section 10 (2016 Prakruta example) | TA p.26, p.29
Calculation method
Combustion (asta) and rise (udaya) dates from the astronomy layer's kalamsha method at Mumbai (date-granular; the 2026 document's convention); East/West as the layer records it. || Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph, sepl/semo 18 files), sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, mean lunar node, whole-sign relationships; condition sampled hourly and every boundary bisected to 30 seconds; times shown in New York local time (EST/EDT by IANA America/New_York) with IST alongside.

Astrological rule
Mercury combustion type (7 types).
Source interpretation
Mercury combustion type (7 types): Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish
Financial market significance
Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
Conditions & qualifications
Type assigned from the combustion's length in days using midpoints between the printed nominal durations (40/30/22.5/18/15/10.5/9); TA p.26 calls Prakruta a 'speed of Mercury', so the type is a speed class and the length is its proxy. | TA p.70: If combustion Bullish but aspected by malefic - Bearish; if Bearish but aspected by benefic - Bullish. | TA p.70: If combust in direct motion: starts Bearish but Bullish after conjunction with Sun; if combust in retrogression it is Bullish. | TA p.70: Bullishness returns after speed of Mercury crosses speed of Venus (see 'Mercury Manifestation'). | Combust/rise dates are civil dates, not instants: the event is date-only.

Type assigned from the combustion's length in days using midpoints between the printed nominal durations (40/30/22.5/18/15/10.5/9); TA p.26 calls Prakruta a 'speed of Mercury', so the type is a speed class and the length is its proxy. | TA p.70: If combustion Bullish but aspected by malefic - Bearish; if Bearish but aspected by benefic - Bullish. | TA p.70: If combust in direct motion: starts Bearish but Bullish after conjunction with Sun; if combust in retrogression it is Bullish. | TA p.70: Bullishness returns after speed of Mercury crosses speed of Venus (see 'Mercury Manifestation'). | Combust/rise dates are civil dates, not instants: the event is date-only.
